Strategy: Reward bins whose post-placement residual fits one or two more items of the same size, widening the earlier two-item band. This covers more reusable residuals than a single band, but the wider bonus may reward many bins and blur into Best Fit.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (25 if r - item >= item and r - item < 3 * item else 0) for r in bins]
```
